name: survey-qa
description: Compare a Forsta Decipher XML survey against a client questionnaire (Word/PDF) and surface QA findings. Doc-side authoring uses a compact text format parsed deterministically into the unified model.

tools.name: get_workflow_guide
tools.description: Return the survey-qa workflow + compact-format authoring guide. Call once at the start of a QA session.

tools.name: parse_xml
tools.description: Parse a Decipher XML survey file into the unified SurveyModel (deterministic, no LLM).

tools.name: extract_doc_text
tools.description: Extract plain text from a .docx or .pdf, preserving inline bold/italic/underline as HTML tags.

tools.name: check_survey
tools.description: Parse a compact-format doc string, run all QA checks against the XML, and return findings.

tools.name: list_checks
tools.description: List all registered QA checks with their IDs and descriptions.

tools.name: generate_report
tools.description: Write a color-coded Excel QA report (Summary / Findings / Questions sheets).
